# Vallabh Kulkarni

> Software Engineer specializing in Enterprise Automation, AI Engineering, and scalable data pipelines.

## About
Vallabh Kulkarni develops intelligent systems, workflow automations, and backend solutions. He has experience working with enterprise integrations, machine learning models, and modern web applications.

- **Automation & Integrations**: Workato, Salesforce, GCP, REST APIs, Webhooks
- **Frameworks & Frontend**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **AI & Data**: Google Cloud Vertex AI / Gemini API, Deep Learning, BigQuery, PostgreSQL
